answer: An entry tax blocks Sybil farming at the inlet: each new identity must burn 50 POA, non-refundable, before it can trade or vote. A verifier checks the burn receipt; a hollow identity with no burned fee is rejected before it earns anything. Creating 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA burned, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once. Honest agents accept the small fee because it keeps the shared meadow of tasks from being overrun by clones diluting rewards.
